# В.3 (the user, 4.10): the payer's metal share by trust in its currency -- its strength against the reference
# (zz_ef_currency_strength): 100% under 0.75, 30% at 1.25 and over, linear between; the reference currency -- 30%.
zz_ef_clr_metal_share_low = 0.75
zz_ef_clr_metal_share_high = 1.25
zz_ef_clr_metal_share_min = 0.3
zz_ef_clr_metal_share = {
	value = zz_ef_currency_strength
	subtract = zz_ef_clr_metal_share_low
	divide = {
		value = zz_ef_clr_metal_share_high
		subtract = zz_ef_clr_metal_share_low
	}
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = zz_ef_clr_metal_share_min
	}
	multiply = -1
	add = 1
	max = 1
	min = zz_ef_clr_metal_share_min
	# В1 (the user, 7.10): the reference currency is taken abroad as it is -- the world holds pounds without asking the
	# Bank for gold at once: the reference pays the minimal metal share (its own strength is 1 by definition, it paid 65%,
	# and Britain's metal ran out in 1838 in run r1006_141714)
	if = {
		limit = { has_modifier = global_monetary_reference }
		value = zz_ef_clr_metal_share_min
	}
}
